passes: Production LogScreen editor renders clean and dirty states at 375x844, 430x844, 375x667, and with a 140% text proxy at 375px
Same-tab is a no-op; close prompts and Stay preserves editor fields
Explicit discard commits only the requested tab after confirmation
Repeated navigation while Alert is open is ignored; the first destination alone commits
Locked pending status renders across the viewport matrix and 140% text proxy
Pending save displays one locked status and prevents sheet close without prompting
Failed save has one truthful Toast; Continue editing clears only failure intent and preserves fields
Unknown save outcome offers readback/retry only and keeps the draft locked
Existing Toast consumers keep the default Avbryt label
scope: Production LogScreen dirty draft protection and shared navigation gate in a synthetic public/review RN Web fixture
limitations: Native Alert appearance and Android system-back are not tested
Live Supabase mutation/readback, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, physical swipe/keyboard behavior, and app build are not tested
The 140% text proxy is a web CSS approximation
